messages.subject: D-RUG and Tea Time this Thursday! Next Week: The solution to slow run times and memory limitations
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

We will be meeting this Thursday (2/20) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time.

Have you ever crashed RStudio because you ran out of RAM (memory)? Or maybe your code takes hours or days to run? How about this, a collaborator can't get your code to run on their computer but you can't figure out why. D-RUG on 4/10 is for you! Elise will be demonstrating how to solve these problems using RStudio on the new UC Davis high performance computing cluster Hive. Hive is a high performance computing cluster (HPC) that everyone at UC Davis has access to, no buy-in necessary. In order to be able to follow along with the demonstration go to the HPC Onboarding Website for Hive and request OpenOnDemand access for the UC Davis HPC Sponsored Public Group (publicgrp). If you have trouble with this, come to this week's D-RUG or post on Discourse.

Datalab will also be open for Tea Time Thursday afternoon.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360


Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
